topic: Prioritize technical debt remediation for the next quarter.
description: Assess technical debt across the codebase and create a prioritized remediation plan.
investigationInstructions: Catalog technical debt items: code quality, documentation, testing, dependencies, infrastructure.
Assess impact of each item (user experience, team velocity, system reliability).
Estimate effort to remediate each item.
Identify debt that blocks feature development or causes incidents.
Group related debt items into remediation themes.
Create a quarterly remediation roadmap with capacity allocation.
Define metrics to track debt reduction.
evidenceRequirements: Team velocity and feature delivery data
expectedOutputStructure: Executive summary with debt distribution by category
Technical debt inventory (item, impact, effort, owner)
